kjv: them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me (Yahweh)
note: Hebrew leb qamay "heart of my adversaries" is an atbash cipher for Kasdim (Chaldea), like Sheshach for Babel (v. 41); the KJV translates the code-name literally. (Ruach can also be "wind" or "spirit".)
Hebrew sar menuchah is "officer of the resting place", i.e. the official in charge of camp halts on the journey; the KJV's "quiet prince" describes temperament.
